name: Chestnut Grove Farm
description: Chestnut Grove Farm grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples in 897 Greenhouse Rd, VA. The farm is family-run, and its seasons run through spring, summer, and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
